answer: Because the knoll solution is checked at the dawn gate and logged, the relic audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch as a result pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 15 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. A farm of 51 pays that 46 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
